name: 2D1N Dinawan Island Glamping
summary: Escape to Dinawan Island for a relaxing 2D1N glamping adventure. Enjoy crystal-clear waters, snorkeling, kayaking, delicious meals, a bonfire under the stars, and an overnight stay in a comfortable glamping tent on one of Sabah's most peaceful private islands.
description:
Escape the city and experience an unforgettable overnight island getaway at Dinawan Island, Sabah's first glamping island. Located just 20 minutes by boat from Kota Kinabalu, this private island offers pristine beaches, crystal-clear waters, beautiful sunsets, and peaceful tropical surroundings.

Spend your day snorkeling among colorful marine life, kayaking around the island, relaxing beneath coconut trees, or enjoying the soft white sandy beach. In the evening, witness a breathtaking sunset before gathering around a bonfire under the stars.
